verdict.rationale: Angular Elements ([angular-gh-8]) lets Angular components be packaged as custom elements that can be embedded in non-Angular/server-rendered pages, directly matching the incremental-adoption story, and SSR/hydration support ([angular-gh-7], [angular-comm-5]) shows some server-page integration capability. However, evidence is just a bare feature link with no walkthrough, no docs on exact drop-in steps, and no community reports validating ease of embedding into legacy server-rendered pages. Missing for 10: detailed Angular Elements integration docs, a concrete example of adding to an existing non-Angular page, and independent/hands-on confirmation of low friction.
